maker: Noble Machines (formerly Under Control Robotics, UCR)
name: Noble Machines Moby
summary: A rugged legged humanoid for heavy industry that lifts up to 23 kg and is designed for stairs, scaffolding and cluttered spaces, aimed at material transport and inspection on construction sites, in plants and mines; offered through limited operated pilots.

germany.statusNote: Noble Machines (Sunnyvale, California) offers limited RaaS pilots operated by its own team and select platform access via a contact form. Schaeffler (Germany) works with it on actuators, which is not a sales route. No German or EU seller or price found.

notes: Two arms inferred from the maker's 'humanoid' description and its pick-and-place demos; no arm specs published.
Stairs, scaffolding and unstable terrain are design claims; the outdoor claim comes from the 2025 legged Moby version, before arms were added.
The 23 kg payload is stated as lifting/carrying capacity, not split per arm.
